'''May 2000 Rotterdam tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rotterdam, Netherlands on 14 May 2000. It is known from Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d791">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championships-ryloth-21-05-2000d791/ dutch-championships-ryloth-21-05-2000], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 22 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championships-ryloth-21-05-2000d791/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Rotterdam, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
